eyebrow_right: 38 DATED STORIES · 7 REGIONS · FULL DAY MONDAY 23 NOVEMBER 2026
subdeck: Nvidia surges 31.3% on Jensen Huang's return · Ukraine hits Perm refinery & claims Libya strike · Belgian ATC strike halts flights

day_numbers.desc: Lukoil Perm refinery struck by drones
Women in £10m NHS AI cancer trial
Teams set for 2031 Women's World Cup
NZ Day 5 stand to draw India Test

heroes.headline: Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO; stock surges 31.3%
heroes.summary: Board votes unanimously 11 days after his exit; Nvidia says US officials cleared security concerns. NVDA hits $164.88, S&P 500 +4.73% (7,237) and Nasdaq +6.5%.

heroes.headline: Ukraine hits Perm & Novoshakhtinsk refineries, claims Benghazi strike
heroes.summary: Long-range drones ignite Lukoil's Perm plant (>1,500 km deep) and Novoshakhtinsk; Zelenskyy confirms Ukraine carried out Sunday's Benghazi drone strike.

heroes.headline: General strike shuts Belgian air traffic control, grounds flights
heroes.summary: Operator skeyes halts services 06:00–20:00 UTC in nationwide anti-austerity walkout, cancelling almost all Brussels flights as PM De Wever faces budget deadlock.

features.headline: Spain's Supreme Court grants amnesty to Puigdemont
features.summary: Closes 2017 Catalan case, clearing the last legal barrier to his return after ~9 years in exile.

features.headline: UK recognises Rohingya genocide, sanctions 5 generals
features.summary: Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband announces recognition and Myanmar sanctions in the Commons.

features.headline: NASA seeks partners for first lunar nuclear reactor
features.summary: Issues RFP for Lunar Reactor-1 (LR-1), a 20-kW fission plant targeted for launch by 2030.

features.headline: Kospi falls 3.3%; Taiwan bans short sales
features.summary: Kospi drops 5.8% intraday before US rally; Taiwan sets uptick ban and 150% short margin.

features.headline: NHS launches world's largest AI cancer trial
features.summary: £10m EDITH study enrols ~700,000 women across 30 sites to test AI mammogram reading.

features.headline: FIFA ratifies 2031 & 2035 Women's World Cups
features.summary: US, Mexico, Costa Rica & Jamaica host 48-team 2031; UK gets first World Cup since 1966.

features.headline: Car bomb hurts 21 in Colombia; urban drone hits police
features.summary: Blast strikes Meta govt building; Cúcuta police attack hurts 3 (incl. infant) in 1st urban drone hit.

features.headline: Search underway after migrant boat capsizes off Senegal
features.summary: Teams recover bodies south of Dakar after wooden pirogue carrying ~50–100 migrants overturns.

features.headline: US denies Iran F-16 claim; Treasury hits shadow banks
features.summary: CENTCOM rejects Tehran claim a US jet was hit; Treasury sanctions 24+ Iranian exchange networks.

features.headline: NZ bat out Day 5 to draw 1st Test vs India
features.summary: Mitchell (49*) & Phillips (26*) guide hosts to 239-5 off 120 overs after India's 720-9 dec.

briefs.text: EU proposes 22nd Russia sanctions package with bans on Russian teams & flags at EU sports events.
EU Academy hit by AI-driven personal data breach; member states clash on 2028–34 budget.
Hundreds of schools receive 'Death awaits you' bomb-threat emails; police rule hybrid hoax.
58-year-old student dies at Sapienza University during hunger strike over housing shortages.
Cyber agency BSI raises IT threat to critical, warning of autonomous agentic AI attacks.
German Pres. Steinmeier opens Africa tour — first German head of state in Côte d'Ivoire in 43 yrs.
Farmer–herder clashes kill 5 & hurt 6 in Sudan; WFP warns UNSC of trade famine chokepoint.
South Africa's Deputy Pres. Mashatile opens 2nd AWSISA Africa & Global South Water Dialogue.
UNSMIL condemns Benghazi escalation; Sharara oil pipeline reopens, easing global crude.
Nine African oil exporters gain $21.6bn windfall (CREA); Tinubu urges suicide-law reform.
PM Modi & Nepal PM Balendra Shah hold talks, inaugurate cross-border Ayodhya–Janakpur rail.
ICC presidency formally acknowledges & regrets Tajikistan's Rome Statute withdrawal (eff. 2027).
Awami League clashes hurt 30+ in Gopalganj (4 crude bombs); BNP clashes hurt 15+ in Jhenaidah.
Stone-laden truck overturns onto minitruck, killing seven people and injuring two.
Lowy 2026 Asia Power Index keeps India 3rd (tightest China gap since 2018); 30% rice duty eyed.
Reports say China's 4th nuclear carrier nears completion; HK restricts Tai Po fire memorials.
Israeli air strikes kill at least 3 incl. a UNRWA worker; Oxfam warns of 'toxic wasteland'.
Designated PM Eisenkot says no immediate Iran threat requires a strike before govt forms.
Haaretz logs 23 military/police suicides in 2026 (16-yr high); Turkey says PKK left 14 Hakurk bases.
US Sec. Rubio & Qatari PM co-chair 8th US–Qatar Strategic Dialogue on regional security.
IMF Executive Board concludes 6th EFF review, releasing ~$377m immediate disbursement.
El Niño king tides & coastal storms threaten holiday floods; US 10-yr Treasury yield nears 4.97%.
Australian music journalist & Countdown icon Ian 'Molly' Meldrum dies aged 83; state funeral set.
Australia flash services PMI drops to 46.2 (5-yr low); New Zealand joins NATO airworthiness pact.
Bitcoin rebounds near $62,000 & spot gold tops $3,615/oz (+2%) as Brent crude eases to $88–91/bbl.

date_check_text: Every story happened or was first reported on Monday 23 November 2026 (UTC). Left out as earlier days — Sun 22 Nov: COP31 no-deal breakdown, Dymer 186-drone strike, Benghazi corvette sinking (only Ukraine's Monday claim shown at #2), Khartoum UN raid, Ituri Ebola hospital clash, Netanyahu–Eisenkot talks, Co-op Live evacuation, Dhaka highway clash, Las Vegas GP, ATP Finals, HK poll, Democrats' 258 seats, Trump Fox Iran interview, Cikande 24 body bags. Sat 21 Nov & earlier: BepiColombo burn, El Chapo Isidro, Sparta II fire, Somalia envoy expulsion (19 Nov), Kyiv bridges & Peru M6.7 quake (20 Nov). Not yet: World Chess Game 1 (Tue 24), 2nd NZ–India Test (Fri 27).
